text:
Katie: Heads up — planning a short 3-email onboarding drip for launch signups next Monday. Goal: move trial users to first API call + webinar RSVP. Draft segment rules below, please flag issues. cc @Mike @Anjali

Mike: Nice. What's the target audience size? and send windows?

Katie: Target: recent signups last 30 days excluding existing customers and folks who already hit /api/generate. Estimated 4.2k. Send windows: Mon 10am PT (welcome), Wed 10am PT (how-to + quickstart), Fri 10am PT (webinar invite + benchmark). Prefer staggered by cohort timezone.

Anjali: Can we A/B subject on email 1? Two options: "Welcome to Redwood — get your first API call in 5 minutes" vs "Ship LLM features faster with Redwood (quickstart)". Suggest second for dev-focused.

Jordan: For segmentation snippet, use filter: `signup_date >= now()-30d AND customer_type != 'enterprise' AND last_api_call IS NULL`. Also exclude unsubscribed.

Katie: yes. Also need to set utm params: utm_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=onboard_drip_may, utm_medium=email. Add tracking pixel and postback for conversions.

Mike: Content outline for email 2: short how-to, code snippet for Node + cURL, CTA to docs + trial credits. Keep token cost note small. I'll draft.

Anjali: Webinar invite in email 3 — include two CTAs: RSVP and Watch on-demand. Also add segment for APAC send windows (Tuesday 10am SGT) to avoid late-night.

Katie: QA checklist before schedule: 1) Link sanity, 2) UTM correct, 3) Unsubscribe footer, 4) Subject lines A/B ready, 5) Tracking events wired. Who can run a send test to 50 internal users?

Jordan: I can run a test tomorrow morning. I'll create a test segment and drop a screenshot of inbox.

Mike: I'll finish copy today — will post subject variants + preheaders for review.

Katie: Great. For deliverability, let's throttle at 1k/hour for first 6 hours and monitor bounces. @Lucy can you confirm ESP rate limits?

Lucy: Confirmed — ESP rate cap 2k/hr but recommend 1k/hr initial. Also suggest ramp after 6h if health looks ok.

deploy-bot: Scheduled campaign "onboard_drip_may" created in ESP, draft save only.

Katie: Perfect. Last ask — add one tiny survey link in email 3: "what would make you ship faster?" 3 options. Keep it single-click.

Anjali: lgtm. :thumbsup: 

Mike: ack. Will post copy + HTML by 3pm PT.

Jordan: test send complete, attached screenshots (in thread). No major spam flags.

Katie: Thanks team — I'll open the rollout channel tomorrow morning. :party:
